name: @pendex/home
description: The whole Pendex website — marketing home page at / and the user guide + generated API reference at /docs — one package, one Vite build.

scripts.build: bun run docs:api && tsc -b && vite build

_comment: typescript is pinned to 5.9.3 here, overriding the workspace's 7.0.2, ONLY because typedoc (0.27.9, latest as of writing) has no TS 7 support yet — TypeDoc's own tracking issue (TypeStrong/typedoc#3098) says TS7's API is a ground-up rewrite and there's no timeline. This pin is local to @pendex/home (Bun nests it rather than hoisting), so it affects nothing outside this package's own tsc -b / typedoc run. Remove it once typedoc ships TS7 support.
